name: Heartroot Biscuit
summary: A biscuit that feeds a creature for a day and restores a few hit points.
description: Baked in a village with a bad harvest and a good oven. One biscuit is enough for a day, but no one eats just one.

stats.effect: As an action, you can eat this biscuit. You are nourished for 24 hours and regain 1d4 hit points. The biscuit is consumed.
